svg.title: Printed Apple
svg.desc: All dimensions are in millimeters (mm) · the body, stem, and leaf print as one piece
svg.text: All dimensions are in millimeters (mm) · the body, stem, and leaf print as one piece
Body outline only. The stem and leaf sit on top.
The hole is 50.5 mm deep. Its wide grooved part is 32 mm deep.
run from the opening up to 31.5 mm
The hole is round, so the Apple can
70 mm wide, 69 mm tall (77.7 mm with the stem), 44 mm flat bottom. About 212 g solid in resin.
Hole, from the bottom up: 26 mm grooved section to 32 mm, 45° cone to 37.2 mm, 12.8 mm snap hole to a
ledge at 44.7 mm, 14.6 mm hook pocket to 50.5 mm.
The Apple rests on the cone. The mount's hooks catch on the ledge. Every ceiling inside is sloped, so no supports. The 32 mm sticker is separate.
Design sizes. Printed parts land within 0.2 to 0.3 mm of them.
